run_multi_news_preprocessing: run the MultiNews dataset preprocessing to generate k-shot data for multiple random seeds
create_multinews_dataset_instance: create a MultiNews dataset instance that loads the HuggingFace multi_news dataset for text summarization
map_hf_dataset_to_list: map a HuggingFace dataset split to a list of input-output tuples with summarize prefix
load_multinews_dataset: load the multi_news HuggingFace dataset using the datasets library
generate_k_shot_data: generate k-shot training, dev, and test splits from the MultiNews dataset with a given seed
